title: Implement Stripe payment gateway
description: Stripe API integration for checkout with payment intent creation, webhook handling, and retry-safe order updates.
latest_update: Webhook verification is complete. The team is validating idempotent order updates before rollout.
risk: Medium: checkout launch depends on webhook reliability and payment failure handling.

title: Refund processing support
description: Implement refund API and admin support workflow for partial and full refunds.
latest_update: API contract is drafted. Implementation starts after payment gateway stabilization.
risk: Low: dependency on PAY-231, but not blocking the initial checkout launch.

title: Session refresh reliability
description: Fix token refresh race condition that logs users out during long checkout sessions.
latest_update: Patch is in review with regression tests for concurrent refresh requests.
risk: Medium: unresolved auth instability can impact checkout conversion.

title: Checkout observability dashboard
description: Add payment funnel metrics, webhook failure alerts, and latency dashboards.
latest_update: Dashboard shipped with alerts for payment_intent_failed and webhook retry spikes.
risk: Low: improves launch readiness and incident response.

title: Release notes automation
description: Generate release notes from merged tickets and sprint summaries.
latest_update: Template generation works. Needs source citation cleanup before demo.
risk: Low: portfolio demo quality depends on polished report output.
